findings.description: The missing-CA-bundle check now emits a warning instead of raising OSError, so the request continues with a cert_loc that is None or does not exist.
findings.rationale: Trigger: verify=True and DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH does not exist on disk, for example when certifi is loaded from a zip where the extraction call was removed. Mechanism: the changed branch only warns, so execution proceeds to set conn.ca_certs to the missing path or None. Impact: the failure surfaces later as a less clear SSL/FileNotFound error, or the request proceeds with a bad trust configuration, instead of the explicit OSError the title did not announce changing.
